messages:
tim.nguyen: CI microbench failure on PR #19874 — tail latency up ~18% on kernel selector change. Failing test: microbench/kv_warmup_latency. CI link: https://ci.internal/builds/19874 artifacts: flamegraph.svg, perf.log. Anyone on this?

dev-bot: Build 19874-PR failed microbench threshold diff: baseline 3.2ms -> 3.78ms (+18.1%).

sarah.wu: Oof. Is this the autoselect patch? I saw a change to kernel cost table in 19874.

tim.nguyen: Yes. The change biases toward cuda_kernel_v2 for seq_len <=64. I ran a quick local run and saw batch sizes fall from 8->5 under sampler. KV cache hitrate also dropped from 0.82->0.61.

ozzie: Link to perf.log?

tim.nguyen: paste: ```
kv_warmup_latency: baseline 3.2ms
PR: 3.78ms
batch_stats: avg_batch=5.2, active_batch_pct=0.34
kv_hits: 61% (was 82%)
>>> flamegraph snippet shows extra time in kernel_mux.cpp:select_kernel
```

perf-bot: Alert: regression correlated with change 9f3c2 -> kernel-autoselect heuristics. Suggested bisect range: 9f3c2..a4b6d

lena: I can bisect. Quick question: is this reproducible in shadowbench locally with --seed 42?

tim.nguyen: Yes I reproduced with shadowbench --seed 42. Repro trace: https://artifacts/internal/trace-19874.json

mateo: If KV hitrate dropped, could prefetch policy have regressed? Any changes in prefetch window?

sarah.wu: PR didn't touch prefetch directly, but kernel switch could change seq distribution seen by sampler, altering prefetch triggers.

ozzie: Let's bisect and capture profiler: `python infra/perf/run_microbench.py --test kv_warmup_latency --record flame --runs 10`

lena: Bisect started. First suspect commit that flips heuristics is 9f3c2. Current bisect log: commit 9f3c2 PASS, commit b0e4d FAIL. Narrowing…

tim.nguyen: Interesting: b0e4d adds small change to batch timer threshold (12ms->10ms). That could reduce coalescing.

sarah.wu: If batching windows shrank, average batch smaller -> more kernel setups -> higher tail. Can we try increasing timer back to 12ms in a quick patch to see?

mateo: I tested locally: changing timer back increases avg_batch from 5.2 -> 7.9 and reduces tail.

tim.nguyen: I pushed a temporary revert PR that forces timer=12ms: https://pr.internal/19910. CI runner started.

dev-bot: PR 19910 started CI: microbench run queued.

perf-bot: CI results: microbench back near baseline: 3.25ms (+1%). KV hitrate restored to 80%. Looks like timer change mitigates.

sarah.wu: :relieved: So root cause is batch timer tweak + kernel autoselect interaction.

ozzie: We should add a unit to assert batch size distribution in CI golden to catch this. Also add kv hitrate guard.

tim.nguyen: Agreed. I'll update test harness and add a regression note. Also will follow up with kernel-autoselect to consider batching sensitivity.

lena: Marking PR 19874 as rollout-blocker until root cause addressed — we'll keep revert in flight if needed.

dev-bot: Revert PR 19910 merged to main (rollout blocker lifted).

tim.nguyen: I'll open an issue tracking fixes: kernel autoselect to consider batch timer, and a prefetched KV hitrate regression test.

sarah.wu: Thanks everyone. Adding to next retro.
